flow_scenarios: Neutral: spool centered/open, P connects internally to T (open-center), no flow to A or B; LS line unloaded (or held at low tank-level pressure) since neither work port pressurized.

Energized OPEN=B: PVEΩ pilot shifts spool so P flows to B port -> through B-side load-holding/relief branch -> to cylinder-side cartridge (157B7121) -> actuator opens door; opposite port A returns oil to T; LS signal taken from B line (via LS_B branch and its 195 setting limiter) reflects load pressure back to pump.

Energized CLOSE=A: spool shifts oppositely so P flows to A port -> through A-side branch and cylinder valve -> actuator closes door; B port returns to T; LS signal taken from A line (via LS_A branch and its 125 setting limiter).

Overload/relief condition: if pressure in the active work line (A or B) exceeds the work-port relief/counterbalance setting, that relief opens diverting excess flow to T, protecting the actuator/door from overpressure (numeric relief settings not clearly legible except LS limiter values 125 and 195).
Pressure check note (per drawing text): pressure to be verified at 45 bar in neutral/opening condition and at 170 bar during closing operation (handwritten annotation, approximate values as printed).
